name: Blocked too long

trigger.label: When Campus sweeps for stuck work

confirmation.title: Enable this Rule?
confirmation.body: Enabling this Rule has Campus check its condition once a minute and apply its action once per occurrence: a comment from Workspace Rules, a move to Blocked for a person, or a return to Ready. It makes no model requests.

confirmation.title: Archive this Rule?
confirmation.body: Archiving disables this Rule and keeps its revisions and run history.

summary: When blocked for too long (240 minutes), comment on the card.

lock.label: Editable workspace rule
lock.explanation: This Rule belongs to this Island.

action.label: Comment on the card
action.note: Ping the owner if this is still stuck tomorrow.
